content_origin: Original procedural geometry, materials, articulated animation and deterministic lane simulation authored for YUGA. No commercial game models, textures, animation data, code or recordings are included by these files.

art.visual_direction: Fantasy ancient infantry: wrapped cloth, quilted cuirass, dhoti silhouette, spears and round shields, bows and quivers, crowned banner commander. Warm sun and cool moon team palettes.
art.animation: Original deterministic joint poses for walk, aim, windup, attack, hit, fall and banner motion; shared meshes/materials and reused arrow geometry.
art.historical_claim: Stylized invented costumes, not a reconstruction of one historical army.
art.quality_limit: Procedural prototype art; does not establish commercial hero-shooter visual parity.
revision_changes: Flattened tapered cuirass and narrower shoulder caps
Rounded turban, defined neck and rounded shoes
Linen lower garments, leather waist and aged metal with restrained team color
Original leaf spearhead, shaped shield rim and notched banner
Thin muted team annulus replaces solid gold disc

geometry_budget.method: Godot 4.6.3 headless instantiation, recursive MeshInstance3D count and mesh.get_faces().size()/3; source geometry counts, not draw-call or frame-rate measurements

art.review_status: Bounded revision complete; actual gameplay render review pending. No commercial-quality parity claim.

mechanics.overflow: Defer whole mirrored five-unit team pairs; never spawn a partial team. Retire oldest corpses when necessary.
mechanics.reward: Only a confirmed final player hit on a Moon unit grants gold, once. Army kills and assists do not grant gold.
mechanics.scope: Offline opposing armies attack each other and cores; they do not damage the player. No live network integration.

consulted_sources.title: Godot navigation demo character
consulted_sources.application: Read fixed physics update and next-path orientation approach; implementation here instead uses original fixed polylines. No source copied.

consulted_sources.title: Game Programming Patterns — Game Loop
consulted_sources.application: Fixed simulation timestep separated from interpolated visuals.

consulted_sources.title: Game Programming Patterns — Object Pool
consulted_sources.application: Explicit capacity and overflow policy; cleanup clears pending actions and retained unit state. Unit nodes are bounded and destroyed, not a reused object pool.

consulted_sources.title: Game Programming Patterns — Spatial Partition
consulted_sources.application: Per-lane target buckets and a local spatial grid for separation.

validation.interpretation: Deterministic simulation and finite-articulation tests. This is not a rendered performance benchmark, network test or visual quality approval. Symmetric soak contests all three lanes; separate seeded arrival fixtures exercise core damage.
